name: asterion-operations
description: A field operations and maintenance platform for preventing asset downtime.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @asterion/contracts && npm run build -w @asterion/core && npm run build -w @asterion/storage && npm run build -w @asterion/api && npm run build -w @asterion/worker && npm run build -w @asterion/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @asterion/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @asterion/core && npm run typecheck -w @asterion/storage && npm run typecheck -w @asterion/api && npm run typecheck -w @asterion/worker && npm run typecheck -w @asterion/web
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/core/dist/__tests__/*.test.js packages/storage/dist/__tests__/*.test.js apps/api/dist/__tests__/*.test.js apps/worker/dist/__tests__/*.test.js && npm run test -w @asterion/web
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run typecheck
